fact: NIDP says over 5M existing TINs are harmonised with Fayda and Fayda is mandatory for new TINs nationally.
National ID Ethiopia's deck says the Ministry of Revenue has harmonised over 5M existing tax identification numbers with Fayda and made Fayda mandatory for new TINs nationally.
National ID Ethiopia's deck gives over 5M existing TINs harmonised with Fayda.

The Reporter says the Addis Ababa City Administration and the Ministry of Revenues have signed on to the National ID program, agreeing to end their own biometric registration, and that the federal public procurement agency has integrated its data systems with it.

ICTD says that since December 2023 taxpayer registration in Ethiopia has been integrated with Fayda, so each new taxpayer identification number is tied to a Fayda number, while mapping of existing TINs is still a goal.
The deck lists a FIN-based TIN for tax and a Fayda-enabled eHRIS for the civil service among Fayda use cases.
